title: Maryland Manual 1929, general election returns (general election 1928-11-06)

offices.president: President (votes for presidential electors by county; when the page prints one column per elector, the column of each party's first elector, the elector at large listed first); only the 1928 general election
offices.senate: U.S. Senator (United States Senator), not a state senator; only the 1928 general election
offices.house: U.S. Representative in Congress, one table per congressional district; district is the congressional district number; only the 1928 general election, not a primary
